packages/cost-policy (@sos-2/cost-policy): the cost + reliability policy contracts + deterministic reference implementations — task concurrency/cost budgets (typed ALLOW / BUDGET_EXCEEDED denial naming counter and limit with no 11th-hour fabrication / ACCOUNTING_UNKNOWN when accounting is incomplete — incomplete consumption entries are representable and answered honestly, never silently guessed allowances; malformed records are typed rejections), rate limiting over action/executor invocations (typed limit policies, a deterministic fixed-window reference limiter with computed retry-after hints — the P2 typed-outcome discipline), provider health (the four honest statuses UNKNOWN|UNAVAILABLE|DEGRADED|HEALTHY with UNKNOWN as the unprobed default, HEALTHY only with at least one probe and every probe HEALTHY, statuses changing only through observed probe reports, recovery only through new observations — the P7 truthful-stale discipline; the aggregate rule is verified EQUIVALENT to the merged P3 infra/deployment aggregate over every probe-status combination by an acceptance test importing the merged module), dead-letter/retry handling (typed dead-letter records carrying task identity, subject, attempts and last error — the §6 recovery data that survives body replacement; bounded retry with capped exponential backoff — unbounded policies are unrepresentable typed rejections; exhaustion or non-retryable errors escalate to a typed first-class ASK record with a deduplication key — never a silent drop, never an infinite retry) and abuse containment (a task exhibiting configured abuse signatures is suspended pending ASK — the typed TaskSuspensionRecord is observed evidence with matched signatures and the ASK reference, never a silent termination; the human ASK decides resume/restrict/terminate)

The tier vocabulary is an INDEPENDENT typed vocabulary EQUAL to the merged P3 EnvironmentTier set (pinned by an acceptance test importing the merged module).
